attributes.action: Allow Max Heat Limit For School Attendance
attributes.additional_details: A petition to allow schools across the UK to close when temperatures reach over 35 °C in the local area.
attributes.background: Allow schools across the UK to close when temperatures reach over 35 °C in the local area.
